comment.text: Title of a feature tour step that introduces the AI chat functionality in both the Files and Rooms sections.

usage.context:
// 2. AI chat tile is the last one and may sit past the carousel fold.
 canCreateFiles &&
 elementStep(
 '[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]',
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistantTitle"),
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistant", { sectionName: t("Common:Files") }),
 callbacks,
 FILES_TOUR_LABEL,
 6,
 revealQuickActionTile('[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]'),

// 3. AI chat tile, worded as in the Files tour; the banner is admin-only.
 canCreate &&
 showFilter &&
 elementStep(
 '[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]',
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistantTitle"),
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistant", { sectionName: t("Common:Rooms") }),
 callbacks,
 ROOMS_TOUR_LABEL,
 6,
 revealQuickActionTile('[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]'),
